task: Read guard.sh and tell me whether it will correctly block a git commit run against the primary checkout, then fix it if not.

fixture.guard.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
PAYLOAD=$(cat)
CMD=$(printf '%s' "$PAYLOAD" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""')
DIR=$(printf '%s' "$CMD" | sed -n 's/.*-C \([^ ]*\).*/\1/p')
if [ -z "$DIR" ]; then exit 0; fi
case "$DIR" in
  /Users/me/repos/app) echo 'primary checkout' >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
exit 0
